chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, “I saw some blood on my garment while I was performing tawaf.”
He عليه السلام said: “Identify the place, then go out and wash it, then return and continue your tawaf from where you left off.”

key_terms.أَطُوفُ: I am performing tawaf, circumambulating the Ka‘bah
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعَ: the spot or place reached in the tawaf
key_terms.دَمٍ: blood, treated here as ritual impurity affecting worship
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْهُ: then wash it, meaning cleanse the impurity

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he finds blood on his clothing while performing tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for someone who notices blood on his garment during tawaf. He should note the point he reached, leave to wash the impurity, then return and resume his tawaf from that place rather than starting over.
